He was also a temporary bassist for the band Against Me!

TV with one reviewer describing the track as "a great slice of indie punk skewered with great riffs and melodies".

It was the group's first release as a full band with electric guitars, bass guitar, and drums.  The album was produced by Rob McGregor, who would also produce the band's second album "Against Me!  as the Eternal Cowboy" (2003).  The album's title references Guns N' Roses singer Axl Rose, illustrated on the cover.
